sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Mount Balrior's capstone fight — a defiance bar that reopens every 5% health, and a geyser-management problem that snowballs if ignored.

sections.heading: Rising Pressure & breakbar
bullets: Ura maintains Rising Pressure, a stacking buff that increases her damage and reduces damage taken as the fight goes on — breaking her defiance bar (which unlocks every 5% health) stuns her and strips it. Don't fall behind on breaks.
She also pulses <mark>Bloodstone Radiation</mark>, passive damage to everyone every 3 seconds — nothing to dodge, just don't ignore it as free incoming damage.

Standing in Sulfuric Geysers grants her stacking Protection/Might/Resolution — destroy or avoid geysers rather than letting them sit. Geysers come from <mark>Create Titanspawn Geyser</mark>, where she leaps and stomps the ground on impact.

sections.heading: Key attacks
bullets: <mark>Eruption Vent</mark>: a targeted geyser erupts after a delay, leaving a shockwave and a lingering hazard that poisons enemies (and buffs Ura if allies stand in it).
<mark>Pressure Blast</mark>: imprisons a target and nearby players in an eruption — clear it with a bloodstone shard.
<mark>Return</mark>: a whirlpool that pulls players in and teleports them to the arena center — be ready for the sudden reposition.
<mark>Steam Prison</mark>: reflects projectiles and blocks escape — don't rely on ranged burst or movement skills to get out of it.
<mark>Propel</mark>: she launches herself at the furthest player for heavy damage on landing — know if you're the target.

sections.heading: Conditions & adds
bullets: <mark>Sulfuric Acid</mark> (applied via <mark>Acid Spray</mark> / <mark>Sulfuric Froth</mark>) ticks damage every second and applies Exposed every 5 seconds — keep condition cleanse up.
Titanspawn adds spawn alongside the geysers — manage both at once rather than tunnel-visioning on the boss. Break their defiance bars to kill them outright rather than grinding through their health.

sections.heading: Bloodstone shards
bullets: Two players need to be continuously managing dropped bloodstone shards — if one sits for 4-5 seconds without being picked up, it pulses unblockable radiation for 10% of everyone's max health. Some transforms (Death Shroud, Celestial Avatar, etc.) can't pick shards up, so know who's on duty.
At 70% health, <mark>Return</mark> pulls the whole squad together into a rising bubble that needs Dispel to clear.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 hard enrage — defeats the whole squad outright, not just a damage buff.

cmSections.heading: What's different in Challenge Mote
bullets: Titanic Resistance stacks permanently every time her defiance bar breaks — the fight gets harder to CC the longer it goes, so early breaks matter more than late ones.
Geyser defiance bars are much bigger here: Titanspawn Geysers go from 800 to 2,000, Toxic Geysers from 800 to 1,000 — clearing them takes real coordinated CC, not just incidental damage.
Her own defiance bar unlocks every 5% health instead of less often, so you'll be breaking it far more frequently overall.
